name: Trinity League India Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1988, Trinity League India Ltd provides financial advisory services, insurance-related risk, and management consultancy 
services, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TLIL, part of the Trinity Group based in Noida, operates in management and financial consultancy while also engaging in Remote Sensing, GIS, agricultural initiatives, and Water Resource Management supported by drone and AI technologies. In FY25, the company is diversifying into the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of Hydrogel, a potassium and starch-based agricultural product designed to improve soil moisture retention.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.32 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.22% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -24.9% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 213 days.
